p: Serves seafood rice dishes and grilled fish options. The location provides views of the ocean and the Songdo Marine Cable Car.
Serves haemul tang (spicy seafood stew). The stew is prepared with a variety of fresh seasonal seafood, crabs, and shellfish in a spicy broth, designed to be shared by several people.

A typical seaside restaurant offering various grilled whole fish (saengseon gui), such as mackerel and hairtail. The dishes are usually served as a set with rice and several small side dishes (banchan).

This street offers various cafes and pubs with views of the ocean and the Songdo Marine Cable Car. Many places serve light drinks, including craft beer and wine, alongside coffee. Suitable for those seeking a relaxing, scenic evening.
